# R1 job tables (generated by gen/r1gen.py)

Each job: name (set, render_pb_pages P, runner knobs, regtimeline), the exact tool command and the frozen
predictions (quantity = value [hypothesis] label).  The tool is `$T`, staged programs `$S`, the work
directory `$W`.  `set`: control, heldout, repeat, replicate.  `tables/` is the runner's input; this is a view.
Knobs: `trial072c:U` = a 0x072c trial job (U = the 0x0724 peak the gate expects); `s072c` = sample 0x072c only
if the gate passed (run/lib_r1.sh); every `tri` job carries `expectdiff`.

## p-c2: 41 jobs, 40 conditions

```
C2 (pixel): Q276 held out (R2-11).  S1b's p-c generator (s1pix.c_program) with new configurations;
every
configuration is an x job and a y job (source pixel identity), predictions on the x job.
HQ-a/HQ-b: k = 1, 2 (which parity the tag-2 sources have); HQ-none: k = 5.  HG: g23 masks 0x20,
0x08, 0x01 (x bits 5,
3, 0), 0x100000 (HG-xy y bit 4, HG-x never); masks go through a register (an immediate above 127
does not encode; the
register form is validated by c-g23r4, mask 0x10, against S1b's immediate form c-g23).  o4:
complementary writes
under k = 7, 3, 0 and unpredicated.  Direct reads: o0 = g23 / g25 alone (c-rd-pa checks that o0
lands at the pixel's
own position).  Scoring per source: rule agreement (at most max(2, 2%) exceptions among >= 300
decoded o1 sources; the
proposal's '<= 2 of >= 400' would refute S1b's own fit, c-k0 having 6 exceptions of 490), not only
fractions.
```

## g-u1: 21 jobs, 21 conditions

```
U1 (geometry, Q211): the page need U of 17 scenes against HU1 = sgx-pipe's TA model as it stands
(128 bytes a
stream, a page per macrotile that has streams, + 1 global page): residual 0 on all 16 measured U
(a FIT).  HU2 (macrotiles
with streams + 8) is the alternative.  P = 0x422.  U is read as e2a's scorer does (peak of 0x0724
and the free-list walk,
a disagreement is cannot tell for the cell; a kick line other than 'geometry only, the scene left
open' voids a K-scene
cell).  Two boundary pairs on HU1's U (E625's rule: overflow iff P - 0x22 < U): b-2-m96 at U = 24
is P = 0x39 / 0x3a (the
proposal's 0x45 / 0x46 would be U = 36's pair), b-m32 at U = 21 is P = 0x36 / 0x37.  The first two
jobs are the 0x072c trial
(gate after each, see PREFLIGHT.md): u-ctl-1 (U 19), u-ctl-2a (U 29).  Non-library sizes (640x480,
1280x1024, 2048x1536)
run only because the tool's mock accepts them (tests/mock_all.py).
```

## g-c1: 22 jobs, 22 conditions

```
C1 (geometry, Q210/Q273): the fine ladder of the raise limit at 4096x4096, 1500 vertices (and 1350
at five
cells), P = 0x360 .. 0x380.  H-abs: the raise happens iff thr0 + 0x20 = P - 2 <= C, C a constant
in [0x35e, 0x37e)
(E753's controls: raise at 0x360, none at 0x380): along P the outcome flips exactly once, raise to
none.  Two flips or
a no-raise to raise flip refute the monotone form.  HP1: 1350 vertices flip at the same P as 1500
(each of its five
cells equals the 1500 cell at that P).  Knob proof: the job's own 0x0624 rows (P - 0x22).  Void: a
cell whose second run
does not reach thr0.  D36 (side table, never gating): dword 36 = max(0x072c's page count at the
first abort - 2, 0)
in every job, raised jobs held out; scored only where 0x072c was sampled (the gate, PREFLIGHT.md).
After the ladder
the step-1 cell (g-c1f, one job, ONLY=name) fixes C exactly.
```

## g-t2: 7 jobs, 6 conditions

```
T2 (geometry, Q230): clipped polygons, vertex SET, ORDER, prim words and depth words scored
separately.  Model: a
plane runs only when a vertex crosses it (one pass rotates the polygon by one: S1/S1b cut-p's
stored order is the zigzag of
ONE pass); Sutherland-Hodgman over the input edges A->B, B->C, C->A (end vertex when inside,
intersection when crossing);
stored order p1 p2 p0 p3 p(n-1) p4 ...; prim entries index | 16 for a boundary edge over the strip
triangles (0,1,2),
(2,1,3), (2,3,4); depth = 0.5 + 0.5 z (clip-made vertices exactly 0 or 1).  z-slab and z-cut-m-
slope (both planes cut): both orders of the
two planes are frozen (either is a finding).  The proposal's z-cut-m-slope prediction (B kept)
contradicts its own program: B has
z = 2 > w, so it is clipped at x = 0.5 too; the generator's SH gives the frozen 4-vertex polygon.
Controls z-flat099
and z-cut-p; a group counts only if both hold.  z-cut-ym uses vtx_zab_pa1.s (templates/, one line
changed).
```

## g-u2: 9 jobs, 9 conditions

```
U2 (geometry, Q211): the count constant k.  E625's count formula 1 + floor((U + k - thr0) / (thr0
+ s)) with U = 287
(HU1 = E625's measure at 4096x4096) and the default triangle: partial renders = 2 iff k >= 2 thr0
- 256 (s = 0x1f) or
2 thr0 - 257 (s = 0x1e).  Ladder P = 0xa3 .. 0xa9 (thr0 129 .. 135: thresholds 2, 4, ... 14);
controls P = 0xa0 (count 2)
and 0xb0 (count 1) from E625.  Every (k in 2..13, s in {0x1e, 0x1f}) pair is a frozen model: the
scorer lists the pairs
the nine counts leave.  The first cell with count 1 fixes k to within 2, coupled to s by one.  Not
in R1: the three
spacing cells at count 3 after a pause (they depend on the k found).
```

## g-t5: 9 jobs, 9 conditions

```
T5 (geometry, Q230): the sub-pixel cull.  The default triangle scaled about the pixel corner
(32,32) to a bounding box of
0.3 .. 0.98 px (no pixel centre inside: centres are 0.5 from the corner), at 1/1024 px (--tri-unit
10).  HS-ext: an object
iff the extent >= T with T in (0.48, 0.96] (so 0.3 none, 0.98 present, one flip between); HS-area:
iff the area >= A*.
The elongated 0.3 x 0.98 triangle separates them (HS-ext: the outcome of the 0.98 cell; HS-area:
present iff its area
0.147 exceeds the ladder's absent areas and none if below its present ones).  Controls: S1b's
e3k-ctl (present) and
e3k-i-c1e3 (none), re-run; a failing control is cannot tell.
```

## g-t6: 7 jobs, 7 conditions

```
T6 (geometry, Q230): the clamp ladder.  vtx_wclip with x and y scaled by w (in band), block word
14 = the clamp,
chosen where RZ and RN of 1/clamp differ (6e-5 and 1.5e-4 over w 1e-5; 6e-4, 7e-4, 1.2e-3 over w
1e-4) and one cell where
they agree (2e-4 over 1e-5: a miss there is an error beyond 1 ulp).  Objects stay above T5's size
(>= 2.4 px).  Frozen
per job: the RZ word, the RN word, the shrunk position x_in / clamp.  Control t6-ctl = S1b's
e3k-i-c3e5 (0x47023555).
All five separating cells RZ or all RN closes the rounding clause; mixed closes it as 'within 1
ulp, not a rounding
rule' (the simulator accepts either neighbour).
```

## g-c1f: 16 jobs, 16 conditions (pause cells, not in the session)

```
C1 pause cells: the step-1 cell between the ladder's last raise P_r and first silent P_s = P_r + 2
is P_r + 1;
this table holds all 16 candidates so that the freeze covers whichever is needed.  Run with
`run/r1.sh --cell g-c1f f-1500-0x373`.  A raise at P fixes C in [P - 2, P - 1), a silent cell C in
[P - 3, P - 2).
```
